sections.description: A unified, modular workspace platform for any business industry. Supports Real Estate agencies, Photography Studios, and more — all in one plugin with dynamic module switching, industry onboarding, and one-click auto-updates.
sections.changelog:
3.2.53

  • Website Statistics Card Rows Fix: Resolved duplicate curved borders and faux card shadow rendering under each stats row caused by divide-y and rounded corners collision, by implementing straight, thin divider elements between rows.

3.2.52

  • Preview Bar Touch Toggling Fix: Removed touchstart event handlers to prevent immediate double-trigger closing of the page switcher dropdown on mobile/touch screens.
  • Elementor Router & Page Switcher Fix: Fixed routing fallback in cora_canvas_theme_frontend_router so page_id parameter correctly resolves to the active page preview instead of falling back to the homepage. Unified the Elementor preview bar with the high-fidelity custom dropdown component.
  • Preview Cache Prevention: Integrated nocache_headers() to prevent local caching of draft theme assets.

3.2.51

  • Preview Bar Dropdown Fix: Restored dropdown toggling and absolute-positioned custom monochromatic page dropdown selector rendering.

3.2.50

  • Lovable Preview Router URL Mapping Fix: Fixed route redirection and history state mismatches so that selecting a page from the floating preview bar dropdown loads the actual page design instead of falling back to the homepage design.

3.2.49

  • Lovable Connector Revamp: Overhauled the Lovable studio drawer connector and routing mapper. Synced WordPress page template interception to resolve draft preview rendering bugs, routing proxy paths to the live URL, and integrated automatic WordPress page creation directly into the Git Sync execution pipeline with seamless sessionStorage wizard step state persistence.

3.2.48

  • Centered Modals & Enhanced Floating Backlink Badge: Converted Add Page, Menu Item, Rename Page, Change Page Slug, and Theme Rename sliding drawers into centered popup modals with zoom animations. Enlarged the floating 'Made in Cora' backlink badge with 20px border radius, bigger font, and no outline styling.

3.2.40

  • Enhanced Media Modal Select Button & Redundant Handler Cleanup: Upgraded the global wp.media wrapper to inject a premium monochromatic floating CTA button that clones the native toolbar button text, syncs selection state changes, and programmatically triggers the native hidden button on click. Removed ~150 lines of redundant local open-event button injection listeners from coraOpenMediaSelector and coraOpenMediaUploader, eliminating race conditions and duplicate button flickering across all workspace media selectors.

3.2.39

  • Global WordPress Media Modal Visibility Override Fix: Resolved a critical usability bug where the primary 'Select' or 'Insert' button and bottom action toolbar in the media library modal became invisible or unresponsive. Registered a global JS wrapper hook on wp.media and introduced precise CSS resets to guarantee native select controls remain 100% visible, correctly styled, and interactable across all workspace drawers and media selectors.

3.2.38

  • Enhanced User Financial Profile: Restructured Financials tab in Edit User drawer to group fields into clean, visual cards with dynamic split share previewer, payout preferences, and GST tax registration controls.
  • User Actions Expansion & Security: Added Active Session Revocation and next-login forced password change redirection workflow.
  • Platform AI Stack & Active Members Avatars: Integrated multi-platform AI branding logos and enabled native profile picture/Gravatar fallback rendering in active members view.

3.2.37

  • Mobile Responsive Table View Empty State Refinement: Add class overrides for .cora-empty-state-row to make sure empty state message rows render as clean, centered, full-width rows without any blocky card transformations on mobile devices.

3.2.36

  • Automations Badge Wrapping Optimization: Added whitespace-nowrap styling to the active workflows status badge and dynamic lists to prevent text wrapping on narrow layout viewports.

3.2.35

  • Premium Full-Page AI Chat & Search Sync: Converted the inline AI sidebar drawer into a fixed full-screen overlay with centered reading blocks. Deployed truly dynamic universal command search indexing active team members and public developer documentation. Integrated RAG knowledge base sync updates for users/invitations activity logs and launched a searchable developer documentation engine.

3.2.34

  • User-Specific MCP Security & Permissions Gateway: Implemented secure per-user bearer tokens, interactive MCP access configurations inside the sliding drawer settings for AI Employee connectors, and dynamic tool filtration and permission validation based on allowed tool presets.

3.2.33

  • Optimized Remote Update Performance: Lowered update server query timeout from 15 seconds to 3 seconds to eliminate page load blockages on slower networks.

3.2.32

  • Enhanced MCP Control Protocol Gateway: Integrated secure python3 stdio bridge for Claude Desktop and Cursor. Exposed 8 new developer tools mapping CRM, E-Sign Document Vault, Geofenced Attendance Logs, and Shoot Booking APIs. Added a Developer Gateway settings card with a direct script download button and copyable configurations.

3.2.31

  • Inline Resizable AI Sidebar: Integrated Shopify-style inline resizable right-side AI panel supporting dynamic workspace canvas layout resizing, header dropdown conversation resets, settings & width toggle buttons, and keyboard shortcut triggers.

3.2.30

  • Fix HTML Comment Parsing Bug: Fixed a malformed HTML comment in the team users view that caused mismatched div tags, preventing user automation settings from correctly toggling or hiding.

3.2.29

  • Attendance Logs Mobile Redesign: Overhauled the Attendance Logs mobile dashboard with a responsive 2-column analytics grid, side-by-side search filter funnel buttons, stacked employee log cards with profile initials, and a unified dynamic pagination footer.

3.2.28

  • Dynamic Cell Badge Permissions Matrix & E2E Validation: Restored the matrix table custom cell badges with popover selectors, synced the hidden checkboxes for E2E tests, and updated mobile platforms stacked shortcuts tooltips for optimal hover rendering.

3.2.27

  • Dynamic View/Edit/None Permissions Matrix dropdowns restored: Restored the matrix table dropdown cells with custom badge state styles, mobile accordions, and bidirectional event sync listeners.
  • AI & Security Tab & AI Talent Matchmaker: Deployed AI monthly token sliders, MCP permissions grid, session persistence triggers, active session revocation API, and the AI Talent Matchmaker assistant.

3.2.26

  • Desktop Header Refined & AI Stack Restored: Removed the page title user icon container in the desktop view, aligning the "User Management" title cleanly with the left edge of the page. Restored the overlapping AI brand platform stack next to the "Invite User" desktop button wrapper.

3.2.25

  • Mobile AI Shortcuts Stack Integrated: Added the compact overlapping AI brand stack shortcuts next to the Invite button in the mobile header, keeping the interface visual system unified without crowding the text fields or breaking the grid layout.

3.2.24

  • Mobile Header Horizontal Padding Removed: Changed the horizontal padding on the mobile view header container from px-4 to px-0, aligning the header content perfectly with the page layout edges.

3.2.23

  • Mobile Tabs Horizontal Padding Removed: Changed the horizontal padding on the mobile sub-navigation container from px-4 to px-0, aligning the tabs row perfectly with the left and right layout edges of the page viewports.

3.2.22

  • Mobile Tabs Vertical Alignment Fixed: Removed bottom padding offsets from the mobile sub-navigation trigger wrapper. This aligns the bottom active border accent of the dropdown tab perfectly with the sibling navigation tabs, preventing the active highlight line from floating above the horizontal menu baseline.

3.2.21

  • Mobile Tabs Outline Removed: Removed the border outlines and gray box background from the mobile sub-navigation "More" selection button. Styled the trigger text to render completely borderless, aligning with the primary sub-tabs. Integrated a clean, responsive bottom-border accent indicator when an active dropdown option is selected to match the desktop and mobile aesthetics.

3.2.20

  • Attendance Logs Analytics Grid 2-Column Mobile Layout: Optimized the mobile analytics overview cards layout. Converted the 4-cards grid container into a responsive 2-column layout (grid-cols-2) on mobile viewports. Adjusted card padding (p-3.5) and minimum heights (160px) to guarantee all 4 blocks render side-by-side as a clean 2x2 grid without vertically crowding narrow viewports.

3.2.19

  • Attendance Logs Analytics Grid Restored & Redesigned: Restored the "Active Today" and "Late Check-ins" metric blocks to the analytics overview grid. Redesigned all 4 blocks (Active Today, Late Check-ins, Geofencing, Cron Automations) into a high-fidelity 4-columns layout on desktop, utilizing custom squircle placeholder backdrops, structured headers, and inline text description labels to preserve user metric visibility.

3.2.18

  • Attendance Logs Mobile Redesign & Premium Cards: Redesigned the Attendance Logs overview stat cards layout. Removed redundant stats cards (Active Today, Late Check-ins) for a cleaner, high-fidelity 2-cards Geofencing and Cron Automations grid. Standardized the top-left icons inside purple and green squircle containers, added paragraph description copy, and styled the Settings and Cron buttons with thin vector SVG icons. Overhauled the mobile punch logs list to render as a vertical stack of premium card components with left colored user avatars and right navigation chevron icons, maintaining a clean tabular layout on desktop.

3.2.17

  • Attendance Logs Stat Cards High-Fidelity Alignment: Overhauled the analytics overview cards container in the Attendance Logs sub-tab. Standardized all cards to utilize custom monochromatic borders, consistent shadow elevations, and strict 110px min-height constraints. Integrated contextual descriptions in the metrics columns and built dynamic green-accent status indicators and descriptive copy for geofencing parameters and background cron test actions, resolving grid height discrepancies on mobile viewports.

3.2.16

  • Permissions Matrix Mobile Toolbar Improvements: Redesigned the action controls toolbar inside the Permissions Matrix to have optimal spacing, layout alignment, and responsiveness. The search roles input expands to 100% width on narrow screens, secondary actions (Reset, Grant All, AI Trainer) sit inline as a clean 3-column row, and the Save Changes button renders full-width at the bottom. The toolbar items wrap and scale cleanly to prevent visual layout overlap.

3.2.15

  • Permissions Matrix Mobile Redesign: Re-engineered the mobile Permissions Matrix tab into a premium accordion-based card layout. Each role displays role descriptions and access profiles as styled, color-themed dropdown selectors. Within each card, categories expand into custom list items containing compass, stats, bag, and settings SVG icons, clean description labels, and dynamic parent category status indicators (green circle-checks, blue circle-eyes, and gray slash-locks). Clicking individual cell visibility toggles recalculates parent category permissions status in real-time.

3.2.14

  • Mobile Empty State Table Rendering Fix: Added .cora-empty-state-row CSS class to exclude empty state rows (No pending invitations, No custom roles, Loading punch records, No attendance records) from the responsive-table card transformation on mobile. Empty states now display as clean, centered text blocks instead of being wrapped in styled card containers.

3.2.13

  • Invite User Button Rendering Fix: Replaced uncompiled arbitrary bracket classes with standard Tailwind utility classes (py-1.5 px-3 rounded-lg) and added inline CSS rules (padding: 6px 12px !important; border-radius: 8px !important;) to guarantee full rendering across browser environments.

3.2.12

  • Invite User Button Style Specs: Overhauled the Invite User action button formatting to use a exact 6px vertical/12px horizontal padding and an 8px border-radius boundary.

3.2.11

  • Invite User Button Padding Correction: Replaced non-standard layout padding classes on the desktop Invite User action button with standard Tailwind padding rules (pl-4 pr-6) to ensure the text has breathing room and does not touch the right border.

3.2.10

  • Overlapping LLM Icons border-0 & Invite Button Fix: Removed border outlines from all overlapping LLM brand icon shortcut buttons in the desktop header. Removed the gradient wrapper on the Invite User button, making it a standalone clean black pill button with strict whitespace-nowrap and shrink-0 constraints to prevent layout squeezing.
  • Toggles Dropdown Max-Width 100px: Constrained all select toggles in the Attendance Logs filters toolbar to a strict max-width of exactly 100px.

3.2.9

  • Desktop Page Header Icon Removal: Removed the leading icon block next to the page title in the User Management desktop header layout.

3.2.8

  • User Module UI Redesign & Dropdown Truncation Optimizations: Overhauled the Invite User button design to use a holographic metallic border with a vertical divider and a solid black pill background. Applied soft transparent brand fill backdrops to the overlapping LLM platform stack buttons. Assigned max-width and truncate bounds to all inline dropdown filters and locked the minimum width on the employee search input to prevent layout squeeze.

3.2.7

  • Attendance Logs Toolbar Layout & Overflow Correction: Converted toolbar row containers and inline desktop filters into full flex-wrap layouts. Set the search input to fixed width (md:w-48) on desktop to resolve flex squeezing and prevent dropdown filters from overlapping or colliding with action buttons on medium viewports.

3.2.6

  • Permissions Matrix Title & Toolbar Alignment Refactor: Reordered header structure to display title/badge on row 1, description text on row 2, and the action toolbar controls (Search, Reset, Grant All, AI Trainer, Save Changes) left-aligned in a single full-width flex row directly underneath.

3.2.5

  • Permissions Matrix Column Spacing & Badge Style Overhaul: Added whitespace-nowrap and min-width constraints (150px) to matrix columns to prevent header squishing. Overhauled the Global System Lock and Live Sync Active badges with a cleaner, compact monochromatic layout. Added horizontal cell padding (px-4) to rows for a premium, breathing layout.

3.2.4

  • Documentation Role Access & Refresh Disappearance Bug Fix: Fixed client-side SPA navigation gate in admin-script.js which incorrectly redirected authorized users away from the Platform Documentation page (super-docs) on page load. Removed global role-enforcement bypass (|| true) in JS capability check, ensuring correct role preview simulation.

3.2.3

  • Overlapping Brand LLM Shortcuts & Layout Correction: Fixed table nesting div alignment bug, deployed an overlapping flex layout brand platform icon stack (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, YouTube) in User Management header with dynamic context-aware clipboard-copy redirection.

3.2.2

  • LLM Platforms, AI Help Drawer & Granular Permissions Matrix: Integrated LLM provider queries with a dedicated AI Trainer and Doubt Assistant drawer, built a walkthrough video tutorial player drawer, and overhauled the Granular Permissions Matrix with dynamic View/Edit/No Access badge selectors.

3.2.1

  • Workspace Member Edit Drawer & Native AI Optimization: Added AI-driven "Write with AI" bio generator to polish member credentials, fixed data key bindings (specs/analysis) in profile matching assistant, and incremented codebase plugin versioning.

3.2.0

  • Workspace Member Edit Drawer & Native AI Optimization: Overhauled user management list header, integrated AJAX profile skills matching assistant using Gemini/keyword fallback, daily token quota controls, MCP allowed tools configuration, and session persistence parameters.

3.1.19

  • Live Platform Monitor & Presence Tracking: Integrated real-time user presence tracking via the WordPress Heartbeat API (30-second pulses) and Transients API for ephemeral storage. Exposes a 24-hour activity heatmap, live-online users table with active/idle indicators, and real-time activity feed inside the System Health control panel.

3.1.18

  • Workspace Feature Flags & Quotas Governance: Added per-workspace limits and feature flag toggles inside the Platform Control Center. Super Admins can configure customized seat quotas, storage limits, and monthly email thresholds via a right-sliding slide drawer sheet. The platform automatically blocks user creation, file uploads, and outbound emails when limits are reached, and hides modules globally based on active feature flags.

3.1.17

  • Fix Platform Control Panel Disappearing Layout Bug: Resolved the flashing/disappearing layout issue on load by adding the new super subpage slugs (super-users, super-appeals, super-governance, super-announcements, super-health) to both the client-side JavaScript allowed capability enforcer array and the server-side default PHP permissions lists.

3.1.16

  • Enhanced Tab & Sidebar Navigation Sync: Resolved Platform Control Center sub-tabs visibility mismatch by mapping sub-tabs directly to unique sidebar page routes (super-admin, super-users, super-appeals, super-governance, super-announcements, super-health) with server-side authorization check and persistent address bar URL syncing.

3.1.15

  • Broadcast Console & Health Metrics Panel: Added top-bar system announcement broadcasting, sticky warning banner during tenant impersonation, and live hosting resource health monitoring.

3.1.14

  • Clean Rebuild and Version Alignment: Updated platform and core codebase files with clean builds to ensure smooth client-side loading of Platform Control Center resources.

3.1.3

  • Suspension Reactivation Appeal System: Added Account Suspended banner callout on login portal with a right-sliding Reactivation Appeal side drawer sheet. Added backend AJAX handlers (cora_submit_suspension_appeal, cora_super_get_appeals, cora_super_handle_appeal). Updated Super Admin Control Centre with Reactivation Appeals tab, pending appeal badges on suspended workspaces, and 1-click approval/decline review drawer.

3.1.2

  • Workspace Suspension Enforcement & Master Control Sync: Enforced global workspace suspension checks across PHP router and AJAX/REST entry points. Updated Super Admin Control Centre workspace toggles (status, industry, plan) to pass complete parameters and issue real-time monochromatic toast feedback. Added cora_is_agency_suspended(), cora_get_active_workspace_plan(), and cora_workspace_has_plan_access() access controls.

3.1.1

  • Control Centre Industry Management: Display selected onboarding industry profile for prospects and added interactive industry switching with database, option, and user meta synchronization.

3.1.0

  • Document Vault Auto-Restoration & Deletion Fix: Resolved a bug where deleting documents down to 1 or 0 records caused sample mockup documents to auto-restore due to a count threshold check. Updated option initialization logic and ensured document deletions sync across both cora_documents and cora_workspace_vault_docs database option keys.

3.0.9

  • Media Selector CTA & Alignment Fix: Added custom floating select CTA button to media modals guaranteeing single-click asset selection.
  • System Settings Authorization Fix: Updated permission check in system settings handler to allow Workspace Owners to save global settings.
  • Feedback Panel Text Polish: Updated WhatsApp response time text from 'Under 5 mins' to 'Under 1 hour' in feedback panel.

3.0.8

  • Authentication Interface Cleanup: Temporarily disabled the Sign in with Magic Link option in the login portal views to maintain layout focus.

3.0.7

  • Unified Search & Performance Optimization: Added transient database query caching, client-side dynamic search cache, unified debounced sidebar search query parser, and deferred critical script execution tags to boost page load speed.

3.0.6

  • Browser Caching Prevention for REST Calls: Set cache: false on key asynchronous jQuery AJAX GET calls in forms view script (fetchForms and loadFormIntoEditor) to prevent browser memory caching and guarantee new form creation immediately propagates to the list view without requiring manual page reload.

3.0.5

  • Cache-Busting for REST API Endpoints: Implemented nocache_headers() and LiteSpeed cache control headers on forms REST endpoints to prevent stale cached empty lists.
  • Forms Duplicate Load Prevention: Cleaned up client-side JavaScript calls in view-forms.php to ensure form data fetches do not trigger redundant API updates on page load.

3.0.4

  • Forms Duplicate Load Prevention: Removed the redundant initial AJAX request trigger from forms manager page script to prevent overwriting the pre-populated forms array on initial page boot.
  • REST Request Debug Logging: Added detailed debug logging capability to forms list retrieval endpoint to diagnose subdirectory routing authentication failures.
  • Forms List Rendering Pre-population & Cookie Auth Fallback: Pre-populated the forms array directly in PHP inside the forms dashboard view to guarantee forms load instantly on page load. Implemented dynamic cookie-based session verification inside REST/AJAX calls to authenticate requests reliably, resolving the Forms List visibility bugs for Workspace Owners.

3.0.2

  • Forms List Rendering Pre-population & Cookie Auth Fallback: Pre-populated the forms array directly in PHP inside the forms dashboard view to guarantee forms load instantly on page load. Implemented dynamic cookie-based session verification inside REST/AJAX calls to authenticate requests reliably, resolving the Forms List visibility bugs for Workspace Owners.

3.0.1

  • Dynamic Host Origin Integration: Wrapped all localized script variables and printed inline URLs in a dynamic origin helper to prevent CORS blocks and session domain mismatches when accessing the platform via alias domains (e.g. app.heycora.in). Fixes the bug where newly created forms failed to load on alias domains.

3.0.0

  • Major Platform Upgrade v3.0.0: Deployed stable environment packages platform-wide, consolidated Google Profile custom brand icons, and updated feedback interface modules.

2.9.100

  • Forms Tenant-Scoped Security and Data Isolation: Enforced dynamic workspace/agency mapping for form CRUD operations, submissions retrieval, and audit logs. Solved the forms list visibility bug where newly created forms in tenant subsite directories did not appear due to hardcoded agency ID fallbacks.

2.9.99

  • Detailed Save Form Error Toasts: Added comprehensive error message extraction from AJAX/REST failures to help diagnose form builder saving issues immediately in the UI via the Toast alert.

2.9.98

  • Forms Subpath Redirect Fix: Resolved REST API redirect issues on subdirectory/subpath URLs by bypassing standalone router redirect checks for wp-json and admin AJAX requests.

2.9.97

  • Google OAuth Location Picker Integration Fix: Resolved a missing markup issue by restoring the Google business location selection grid view when the user account is authenticated via OAuth but has not yet linked a specific storefront listing.

2.9.96

  • Credential Exposure Protection: Replaced plaintext Google Maps API Key input with a password mask inside onboarding view, preventing key leakage in source HTML and DOM.

2.9.95

  • Google Places API Connection & Live Reviews Fetching: Retrieve real reviews via Places API Key, dual unconnected option layout, and copyable redirect URI instructions in the keys panel.
  • Reviews & Google Business Profile 1-Click Demo & Drawer Integration: Added 1-Click Demo Setup button in API Credentials drawer sheet, auto-trigger credentials drawer when Client ID is missing, and integrated authentic demo sample reviews fallback for Place Search connected listings.

2.9.92

  • Reviews & Feedback UI & Pro Lock Polish: Updated section heading typography scale, Pro Tier lock banners on AI generator & 30-Day PDF report engine, soft-tinted preset cards, zero mobile outer padding, and header logo letter-spacing adjustments.

2.9.91

  • All Forms Submissions Route & Funnel Aggregation: Added REST API route GET /cora/v1/forms/submissions to aggregate submissions across all forms. Updated Advanced Funnel Analytics tab to fetch and aggregate field completion rates across all forms when 'All Forms' is selected.

2.9.90

  • All Forms Submissions Route & Funnel Aggregation: Added REST API route GET /cora/v1/forms/submissions to aggregate submissions across all forms. Updated Advanced Funnel Analytics tab to fetch and aggregate field completion rates across all forms when 'All Forms' is selected.

2.9.89

  • Forms Builder & UPI Payments Overhaul: Fixed async popup window blocking on View button click by pre-opening blank tab synchronously before auto-saving draft; added UPI ID and UPI QR payment field types with live canvas preview and public checkout rendering; updated field sidebar (removed PRO badge, added UPI fields); added inline block insertion divider buttons; fixed hash navigation redirect after publish.

2.9.88

  • Forms Module & Header Polish: Fixed REST API subpath routing with dynamic getCoraRestUrl(), added explicit Save Draft button with Unsaved Draft status indicator, auto-save before back navigation, and fixed desktop sidebar top margin gap.

2.9.87

  • Forms Module REST API Routing & Unsaved Draft Preview Fix: Replaced hardcoded root-relative REST API URLs with dynamic getCoraRestUrl() resolution to prevent 404 errors on subpath sites (e.g. app.heycora.in/test-1/). Added seamless auto-publish pipeline when clicking View or Share on unsaved form drafts.

2.9.86

  • E-Sign Base64 Signature Image Escaping Fix: Replaced esc_url() sanitization with esc_attr() in public-doc-view.php signature card stamp containers. Fixes a bug where WordPress esc_url() stripped base64 data URIs (data:image/png;base64,...) resulting in empty image src attributes on shared document links.

2.9.85

  • SMTP Relay SSL Bypass & Default Option Fallback: Added SSL certificate verification bypass to PHPMailer settings in cora_configure_phpmailer_smtp and fallback for cora_smtp_enabled in cora_get_default_smtp_settings() to ensure seamless email delivery across environments.

2.9.84

  • Direct E-Sign Email Sharing Fix: Wired the Share Document Access modal's 'Send' button to execute the cora_share_document_email AJAX controller, generating secure client access hashes and dispatching signature request emails.

2.9.83

  • Workspace Editor Redirect: Configured Edit Studio to directly load step 3 (Build Document) of the document wizard instead of step 1 (blueprint selector) of dynamic document creation.

2.9.82

  • Security & Tenant Stability Improvements: Relaxed settings in-app updater capability checks to allow Workspace Owners and Super Admins manual update checks. Added SSL verification bypass to remote update checkers. Resolved e-signature validation token errors for guests under multi-tenant isolation filters.

2.9.81

  • Client-Side Performance Optimization & CDN Asset Localization: Localized all external render-blocking CDN resources (QuillJS, ChartJS, TomSelect, CodeMirror, Tailwind CSS, jQuery, and Canvas Confetti) inside the plugin assets directory and applied async/defer execution tags. This resolves page parsing blockages, mitigates external DNS/SSL lookup timeouts, and enables native-like load speeds for the Workspace.

2.9.80

  • Public Secure Share Link Generation: Upgraded document share modal and share drawer to generate public secure links of the form /shared-doc/{hash} instead of dashboard links requiring login. Enforced automatic secured shares setup on document creation and page load fallback so shared files are immediately viewable by clients without authentication.

2.9.79

  • SEO & GEO Rank Drop Monitoring Trigger: Implemented daily rank monitoring check (10:00 AM) that tracks target keyword SERP positions and AI citations. Added automated, monochromatic alert email dispatches to Workspace Owners. Cleaned up emoji tags in automation subjects, registered the daily cron schedules, and integrated rank-drop check manual tests in the AJAX suite.

2.9.78

  • Mobile Layout & Width Constraint Optimizations: Integrated strict layout constraints (w-full max-w-full) and dynamic flex stretch/items alignment across the SEO Analyzer panel, layout wrapper, and main analysis area. Fixed card overflow and badge clipping on mobile viewports.

2.9.77

  • Sidebar Top Group Label Spacing & Padding Optimization: Reduced excess top margin on .cora-nav-group-label and eliminated top margin for the first navigation group sitting directly underneath the sidebar search bar, creating a clean, tight, and compact transition into the navigation menu.

2.9.76

  • Automated Owner Digests & Security Alert Control Suite: Built autonomous email automation engine delivering Morning Operational Kickoff Briefs (08:30 AM), Mid-Day Geofence Anomaly Audits (14:00 PM), Evening Business Intelligence KPI Summaries (18:00 PM), Real-Time Security & Role Elevation Alerts, and Sunday Payroll Preparation Digests directly to Workspace Owners without manual checking. Added new Automated Digests & Alerts control tab inside User Management with real-time toggle switches and on-demand test dispatch functionality.

2.9.75

  • Mobile Layout & Structure Overhaul: Re-engineered Attendance Logs filter toolbar with compact inline search bar and collapsible mobile filter panel. Removed horizontal swipe tracks on mobile Permissions Matrix and converted role cards into a vertical stacked grid. Aligned matrix action buttons into a clean 3-column row grid on mobile.

2.9.74

  • Mobile UI & Scroll Overhaul: Fully resolved vertical scroll locking on mobile viewports. Replaced all invalid zinc-150 border tokens with standard system borders to eliminate black outlines. Built a premium swipeable cards UI for the Permissions Matrix with collapsible category accordions, and optimized the Attendance Logs stats widgets into a 2x2 grid. All local Playwright E2E tests verified and passed.

2.9.73

  • Dynamic Roles & Mismatch Resolution: Upgraded the user management module, registration forms, email notifications, audit logs, and universal search category subtitles to resolve dynamically created custom roles to their human-readable labels instead of raw system keys. Verified and passed all local and remote E2E tests.

2.9.72

  • Staging & E2E Testing Synchronization: Verified clean Custom Roles addition/deletion operations, Permissions Matrix autosaves, and dynamic industry-scoped label swaps on the remote staging environment (app.heycora.in) with 100% passing E2E Playwright test assertions.

2.9.71

  • Custom Roles E2E Verification: Created and verified local custom roles E2E test suite covering addition, editing, duplication, deletion, and dynamic industry-scoped accessibility labels in both Real Estate and Photography Studio workspaces.

2.9.70

  • Custom Roles AJAX Hooks Alignment: Resolved AJAX hook mismatch by registering all variations (e.g. wp_ajax_cora_ajax_add_custom_role) matching client JS $.post requests, and cleaned up legacy duplicate delete declarations while keeping tenant-scoped option keys.
  • Dynamic Industry-Scoped Feature Accessibility: Converted permissions checkboxes in Create/Edit Custom Role drawers, table labels, and Permissions Matrix column headers to resolve dynamically based on the active workspace industry (e.g. Real Estate vs Photography Studio) using $is_studio_mode.

2.9.68

  • Workspace Member Retrieval & Multi-Agency Query Resolution: Fixed branch key normalization and lookup mappings in User Management grid for standard and numeric branch IDs, and bypassed filtering restrictions for Workspace Owners to ensure all members and invitations render correctly.

2.9.67

  • Missing Script Tag Fix in Auth Templates: Restored omitted opening <script> tags in authentication and invitation layout templates (setup-account, register, forgot-password, reset-password) preventing raw script source from leaking into the UI.

2.9.66

  • Workspace Member Retrieval & Multi-Agency Query Resolution: Standardized user query resolution to handle multiple agency identifiers (integer IDs, slug keys, and agency_ prefixes) and bypassed branch filtering for Workspace Owners. Added role and tenant bypass checks to database query functions (leads, clients, properties, bookings, ledger, invitations) so all member records render correctly.

2.9.65

  • Tenant-Scoped Geofenced Attendance & Office Locations: Scoped geofencing settings dynamically to cora_office_address_{agency_id} to prevent cross-tenant settings overwrites and restored office coordinates/address lookup mapping in settings drawer.
  • Custom Roles Access Control & Dynamic Sidebar: Enabled custom roles management for workspace owners, enforced capability verification server-side, and dynamically filtered sidebar navigation menus based on permission matrix.

2.9.64

  • Detect Current Location Option: Integrated a location-detect button (crosshair icon) into the geofencing address input inside the Office Location side drawer. Uses the browser's Geolocation API to fetch GPS coordinates, update the live map, and perform reverse-geocoding via OpenStreetMap's Nominatim API to resolve street addresses automatically.

2.9.63

  • Syntax Error Fix for Global Actions: Resolved an unclosed bracket syntax error in copyAttendanceShareLink() that caused JavaScript compilation to fail and froze the UI on the members page.

2.9.62

  • Drawer Trigger Position, Interaction & Global Event Binding Fixes: Standardized side drawer sheets for User Editing, Custom Role Editing, and Attendance Reports. Added inline style overrides to force correct flex display, visibility, and transition states on open/close events by removing translate-x-full and pointer-events-none.
